text:
jamie: Hey team — customer (acct: acme-co) reports intermittent 500s on /v1/generate. They gave a request_id: req_0a1b2c3d. Error happened around 2026-03-15T10:12:03Z in us-west-2. Can someone do a log lookup and confirm retention window?

ryan: Can you paste the full request_id (exact string) and the raw curl they used? Also tell me if they used streaming mode or non-streaming.

jamie: Full ID above is exact. Customer said they tried both streaming and non-streaming; attached their simplified curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-xxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-1","input":"hello","stream":false}'
```
They also included a second failing request: req_9f8e7d6c (same timeframe +2m).

maya: Okay — quick notes: hosted prod logs are retained 30 days in our elastic cluster; customer-visible request logs older than 30d are archived to S3 (archive retrieval 24-72h). For immediate lookups use the live log index. Use this query in Kibana/logs UI: 
```
(request_id:"req_0a1b2c3d" OR request_id:"req_9f8e7d6c") AND service:api-gateway
```
Filter by @timestamp between 2026-03-15T10:10:00Z and 2026-03-15T10:20:00Z. :mag_right:

nate: If you want the raw API to pull logs programmatically (internal tool): 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $LOG_READ_KEY" \
  "https://logs.internal.redwood.ai/search?q=request_id:%5C\"req_0a1b2c3d%5C\"&from=2026-03-15T10:00:00Z&to=2026-03-15T11:00:00Z"
```
That returns JSON lines with the full traces. Replace with req_9f8e7d6c for the other.

logs-bot: Reminder: if the request is older than 30 days it will not be in the hot index. Use /support/debug-bundle to request archived bundle retrieval. Archive retrieval ETA: ~48h.

ryan: Also check trace sampling — if the trace was sampled out there won't be a full span trace. Look for trace.id in the gateway logs (field: trace.id). If you have trace.id we can pull the long-running spans.

jamie: Customer says they don't have trace.id. They only have the two request_ids above.

maya: Fine — run the Kibana query and then grep for "status_code" and "backend_latency_ms" fields. Typical investigation flow: 1) find gateway log for request_id 2) inspect upstream backend response 3) if backend returned 5xx, open incident ticket with the service owner and attach log lines.

nate: If you want to repro locally, ask customer to run this minimal curl (non-streaming) and include full response headers: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-xxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-1","input":"ping","stream":false}'
```
We need full response body + headers. If they see a 500 please capture request_id from the response header `x-redwood-request-id` and paste it here.

support-bot: To speed debug, you can request a debug bundle: `/support debug-bundle create --request-id req_0a1b2c3d --reason "customer 500s"`. That collects traces, proxy logs, and runtime dumps for 7 days. Note: debug bundles for archived intervals will trigger archive retrieval.

jamie: Customer ran the suggested curl and returned a 500. They captured header x-redwood-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d (same). They also sent response snippet: `{ "error": "internal_error", "request_id": "req_0a1b2c3d" }`.

maya: I've pulled the gateway line — here's the quick snippet (sanitized): 
```
@timestamp: 2026-03-15T10:12:03Z service: api-gateway request_id: req_0a1b2c3d status_code: 502 backend: model-router backend_status: 502 backend_latency_ms: 1345 trace.id: trace-7a8b9c
```
Backend (model-router) returned 502 after ~1.3s. I'll ping model-router owners. :phone:

nate: Forwarding to #eng-runtime owners. Also note: if this customer needs longer retention consider Dedicated or Private deployments; Hosted default hot retention is 30d.

ryan: We'll need the debug bundle (to capture model-router stack traces) and the full kube pod logs from model-router for that time window. Jamie — can you ask customer to approve debug bundle collection? If they decline, we can still try to pull logs server-side but it slows things.

jamie: Sent the approval request to customer. They approved. I created debug bundle request id db-5583 via support-bot. ETA 2h for collection because it includes archived artifact retrieval.

maya: Once bundle arrives I'll correlate trace.trace-7a8b9c with the model-router logs and post findings. If anyone wants to triage with me live, ping. :eyes:

jamie: Thanks everyone — keeping thread open until we have bundle. :thumbsup:
